Creamy Buldak Loaded Noodles 🍜🧀🥓 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 2 slices mozzarella cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 1 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil, plus extra for topping Buldak sauce, to taste 2–3 tbsp heavy cream Chopped green onions Shredded mozzarella cheese, for topping Toppings Crispy bacon Fried egg Sausage Dumplings Or any toppings you like Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles until half cooked, then drain. In a pan over low heat, add the mozzarella cheese slices and baby Swiss. Let them start to melt. Add ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, and green onions. Mix everything well. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with shredded mozzarella cheese, then cover and let it melt. Finish with crispy bacon, a fried egg, sausage, dumplings, or any toppings you like. Drizzle with more chili oil and top with green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! . #buldak #buldakramen #ramen #cooking #Recipe

Drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the baby Swiss, American, and Monterey Jack cheese slices. Add the mayo, Buldak sauce, Buldak powder, chili oil, minced garlic, and green onions on top of the cheese. Mix everything together until the cheese melts into a thick spicy paste. Pour in the heavy cream or milk and stir until smooth and creamy. Add the cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce.
